item.summary: fix(ios): stop blaming device storage for incomplete Gateway setup (#130407) * fix(ios): distinguish incomplete gateway setup from credential save failures Record received and persisted device-auth roles separately, and centralize setup handoff failure handling without changing credential grants or persistence policy. Related: #108888. Thanks @rhubain for reporting the misleading recovery guidance. * fix(ios): refresh handoff diagnostic localization inventory
